domain_description: A read-only Shanghai place directory containing place attributes, FSQ category hierarchy, place-category links, unresolved quality flags, and build metadata.
queryable_scope: Place counts, names, contact availability, locations, coordinate ranges, creation, refresh and closure dates
Category distributions, rankings and comparisons across locality or region values
Places without categories and places linked to multiple categories
Unresolved data-quality flags and dataset build metadata
table_relationships: Use places JOIN place_categories JOIN categories for category analysis
Use LEFT JOIN from places when uncategorized places must remain in the result
value_notes: Use places.canonical_district for comparisons across the 16 Shanghai districts; NULL means locality, region and admin_region did not identify one district unambiguously
locality, region and admin_region remain raw source values and may contain English, Chinese, case and administrative-level variants
place_categories.is_primary=1 means the first source array item and is inferred, not an official primary-category assertion
A coffee-shop request normally maps to categories.category_name = 'Coffee Shop'; inspect schema and values when the wording is ambiguous
query_guidelines: Use only read-only SQLite SELECT statements
Use deterministic ORDER BY for rankings and LIMIT for place lists
Prefer COUNT(DISTINCT places.fsq_place_id) when joins could duplicate places
Treat blank contact strings as missing as well as NULL
unsupported_questions: Real-time foot traffic, live opening status or navigation routes
Revenue, rent, user ratings, reviews, sentiment or future forecasts
Any business metric or attribute absent from the inspected SQLite schema
